In detail

Post-war housing north of the centre, and the wijk Utrecht's own figures put at the top: 646 police registrations for youth nuisance in 2025, the highest in the city, and rising for several years running — up 46% in 2025 alone, a sharper jump than the years before. Utrecht publishes police registrations and survey results by wijk through its own research office. Registered crime across the city rose 10% in 2025, driven by home burglary, thefts from cars, bicycle theft and violence, and 59% of residents reported seeing at least one suspicious situation in their neighbourhood that year. It is also the subject of a dedicated municipal programme, Samen voor Overvecht. Residential, with nothing that brings a visitor here.

This specific area was reviewed against credible local sources — local and national news, municipal and police-published material, and official surveys where they exist — and the signals were consolidated across sources rather than taken from any single report, with the reasoning and the sources shown above. Utrecht publishes no comparable neighbourhood-level crime dataset; where a city does publish one, Wandroz uses it instead of an assessment. Where a review finds nothing documented, that is recorded as no findings rather than as a safety rating.

Frequently asked questions

Is Overvecht safe?

Wandroz currently rates Overvecht in Utrecht as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Utrecht during the day and roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Utrecht at night. This comes from a structured local-source assessment: an area-level review of credible local sources — local and national news, municipal and police-published material, and official surveys where they exist — consolidated across sources rather than taken from a single report. Utrecht publishes no comparable neighbourhood-level crime dataset; where a city does, Wandroz uses it instead.

Is Overvecht safe at night?

At night, Overvecht is rated as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Utrecht. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Overvecht a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Overvecht's day rating (relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Utrecht) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late. You can search accommodation already filtered to this specific area using the Booking.com link on this page.

Is there official crime data for Overvecht?

Not an official government crime feed — Overvecht's rating comes from Wandroz's own current local/national press and survey research for this specific area instead (see the note on this page for what was checked and the sources used).
